identity.title: Peter Atkins debates Stephen Law - Science or philosophy, which is best? (World Humanist Congress)
identity.dateBasis: The Humanists UK publisher description explicitly identifies the 2014 World Humanist Congress in Oxford, Peter Atkins, Stephen Law, and chair Pavan Dhaliwal. Public player metadata gives upload date 2015-05-22; the event year is 2014, not the upload year.
identity.speakerIdentityBasis: The Humanists UK publisher description explicitly identifies the 2014 World Humanist Congress in Oxford, Peter Atkins, Stephen Law, and chair Pavan Dhaliwal. Public player metadata gives upload date 2015-05-22; the event year is 2014, not the upload year.

acquisition.method: YouTube public Innertube Android player captions; srv3 XML normalized locally

content.coverageNote: The full public caption track reaches the recording end. All full-recording bytes are preserved; judgment access is restricted to the separately locked approved formal-rounds packet.

participants.basis: Only Atkins and Law advance arguments within the approved openings and first rebuttals. Moderator transitions are procedural. All subsequent audience material, participant replies, concessions and concluding comments are outside assessment.

formalRoundsScope.scope: Only the opening statements and first rebuttals are assessed. Introductory material and the entire subsequent audience-question portion, including both speakers' later replies, concessions, and concluding comments, are excluded. Moderator logistics within the approved window are not scored.
formalRoundsScope.requiredReaderDisclosure: Only the opening statements and first rebuttals (3:01–28:50) are assessed. The entire subsequent audience-question portion, including both speakers' later replies, concessions, and concluding comments, is excluded; neither speaker receives credit or penalties for that material. These scores are not an assessment of the complete recording.
